WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.product_type_description,
        AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) as avg_quantity,
        AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_cost_diff
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
    INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
    INNER JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
    GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_cost_diff) as mean_cost_diff
    FROM category_stats
),
filtered_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.avg_quantity,
        cs.avg_cost_diff,
        cs.avg_cost_diff - om.mean_cost_diff as exceeds_mean
    FROM category_stats cs
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
    WHERE cs.avg_cost_diff > om.mean_cost_diff
)
SELECT 
    AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_of_avg_quantities,
    AVG(avg_cost_diff) as avg_of_avg_cost_diffs,
    AVG(exceeds_mean) as avg_of_exceeds_mean
FROM filtered_categories

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity values (stored as VARCHAR) are numeric and can be cast to DECIMAL
